data.title: Add /brand-page skill + PostToolUse hook: regenerate <dir>/index.html from <dir>/BRANDING.md

data.body:
Review (self-review, see caveat). Verified against plan acceptance criteria:
- sh -n clean; script is 0755; all 6 acceptance criteria exercised.
- Parser tested on all three fallback paths (jq / python3 / sed) by restricting PATH; each emits correct additionalContext.
- Negative cases all exit 0 silently: non-BRANDING path, missing file_path, malformed JSON, empty stdin.
- Emitted payload round-trips through jq.
- Added a guard not in the original plan: a root-level BRANDING.md is suppressed, since the skill forbids touching root index.html and the hook would otherwise emit a contradictory instruction.
- settings.json is valid and separate from the pre-existing settings.local.json (personal permissions untouched).
- No loop risk: hook matches BRANDING.md only, skill writes index.html only.

Not verified: end-to-end skill execution. Both BRANDING.md files are empty (0 bytes), and the skill is designed to refuse on an empty brief, so there is nothing to render yet. Skill discovery also requires a session restart since skills load at startup.

CAVEAT: this review was performed by the same agent that wrote the code. The session was configured to disallow spawning sub-agents, so the CLAUDE.md fresh-context review boundary was not achieved. Flagged to Forrest rather than forced past silently.

Meets acceptance criteria. No rework needed.
